scope: Korean EGA/FGA terminology workflow; bounded review for quasi-compact/separatedness/formal-scheme/completion vocabulary

sources.title: On Noetherian schemes over (C, tensor, 1) and the category of quasi-coherent sheaves
The derived category of quasi-coherent sheaves and axiomatic stable homotopy

review: All three primary papers repeatedly preserve the typed distinctions among quasi-compact, quasi-separated, semi-separated, Noetherian, quasi-coherent, formal scheme, ideal of definition, underlying space, adic, support, morphism, restriction and completion. The review is a terminology witness and does not authorize a Korean lexical form by itself.
decision: Keep the locked Korean forms 준콤팩트, 준연접, 뇌터, 형식적 스킴, 정의 아이디얼, 바탕공간, 준아딕, 분리 완비화, 사상 and 연속사상; check every new term against the French definition and a retained primary-paper context. Do not collapse quasi-compact into compact, semi-separated into separated, formal scheme into underlying space, or completion into completed global sections.
next: Apply this bounded source-context check before each new EGA/FGA/SGA unit and record any lexical change in the durable terminology ledger.
